vulnerable_code:
class MatchLobbyChannel < ApplicationCable::Channel
  def subscribed
    # Fails to check if match is private/invite-only before opening spectator stream
    stream_from "match_#{params[:match_id]}_spectate"
  end
end
diagnosis: MatchLobbyChannel permits streaming match spectator events without checking whether the match is an unlisted private scrimmage. Opposing teams can eavesdrop on private lobby team compositions and in-game draft communications.
corrected_code:
class MatchLobbyChannel < ApplicationCable::Channel
  def subscribed
    match = Match.find_by(id: params[:match_id])
    reject unless match && (match.public_spectate? || match.participant?(current_user))

    stream_from "match_#{match.id}_spectate"
  end
end
